commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Federico La Penna due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Adam Masina (Torino) and his team.
90+2' 15:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

89' Joaquin Correa (Inter) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
86' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
84' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
80' Here's the change. Samuele Ricci leaves the pitch and Ivan Ilic (Torino) comes on as a substitute.
80' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Valentino Lazaro will be replaced by Alessio Cacciamani (Torino).
79' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Francesco Acerbi (Inter).
77' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:9.
73' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

70' Joaquin Correa (Inter) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
68' Nicolo Barella (Inter) releases Joaquin Correa, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
66' The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
63' Substitution. Cesare Casadei (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gvidas Gineitis walks off.
63' Here comes a substitution. Sergiu Perciun (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Ali Dembele.
62' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Barella (Inter) replacing Piotr Zielinski.
62' Substitution. Nicola Zalewski is replaced by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
61' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
58' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
58' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
56' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

56' Federico Dimarco (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
56' Torino seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' 0 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kristjan Asllani (Inter) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic no chance!
49' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
47' It's a penalty to Inter! Let's see who's going to take it. Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) for his blatant foul.
47' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Yann Bisseck (Inter) comes off for Denzel Dumfries.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is replaced by Federico Dimarco.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Free kick. Inter will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45+5' The resulting free kick from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45+5' Federico La Penna blows for a foul after Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45+3' A cross from a corner kick by Torino is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+3' Samuele Ricci (Torino) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
45+3' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Torino.
45+3' Josep Martinez (Inter) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+3' Josep Martinez (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+2' Che Adams (Torino) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' Torino will take a free kick.
43' Yann Bisseck (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
41' Che Adams (Torino) tries to find Nikola Vlasic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

37' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
37' Corner kick. Torino will have an opportunity.
36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
35' Josep Martinez (Inter) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Josep Martinez (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Federico La Penna blows the whistle, Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Torino in a dangerous position.
30' Ali Dembele (Torino) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
28' Inter earn a corner.
28' The game is interrupted.

26' Matteo Darmian (Inter) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
26' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
25' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is given a yellow card.
23' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) and Stefan de Vrij combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
20' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
19' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
18' Matteo Darmian (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
16' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.

14' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Nicola Zalewski (Inter) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Alessandro Bastoni, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
13' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sprays a pass out to Matteo Darmian, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
11' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Alessandro Bastoni.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
2' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' Torino exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
